clips.title: The story
paras: Morin Cloudstalker is a tauren scout keeping watch along the road leading east from Bloodhoof Village toward the Barrens in Mulgore. Standing vigil over the plains, he monitors local trade routes and investigates the encroaching threats endangering tauren travelers.

Positioned beside the dirt path winding east toward the Barrens, Morin Cloudstalker acts as both a scout and a guardian for travelers through Mulgore. The grassy plains here are usually peaceful, but the opening of trade routes and shifting territories have drawn opportunists and bandits dangerously close to the heart of the tauren homeland.

Morin's scouts recently attacked and burned a Venture Co. caravan on the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. When goblin salvagers were spotted near the burned wagons, he sent adventurers to examine the surviving supply crates and learn what the Venture Co. was hauling.
